Spurs @ Kings 4/10 9:00 - Wemby and Fox questionable, should win
Blazers @ 76ers 8/10 6:00 - Embiid questionable, should be close
Grizzlies @ Hornets 4/10 6:00 - Young Grizzlies against a gutted Hornets team

games.notes: Embiid questionable; Morant and Sharpe out for Portland. Best game on the board: Philly at 14-3 against a young Blazers team, should be close if Embiid plays.
Wembanyama and Fox questionable, Harper out. Kings are 2-14 without Simmons, so the Spurs should win easily, but the stars' status decides if it's worth your night.
Boozer and Grant out for Memphis; Knueppel, Allen and Schroder out for Charlotte. Young Grizzlies should handle a gutted Hornets team, watch for the rookies.
J. Williams, Caruso and Holmgren out for OKC; Haliburton out, Siakam questionable for Indiana. Both on the second night of a back-to-back, a watered-down matchup.
Zion probable, Mark Williams out for Phoenix. Two teams going nowhere; only worth it for Zion.
Beal out for LA. Rockets are a real contender but the Clippers have little left, likely blowout.
Reaves out for LA; Markkanen, Jackson and Hayes out for Utah on a back-to-back. Likely blowout.
Bradley questionable, Barrett and Leonard out for Toronto. Worst team in the league against a banged-up one, skip.
Edwards out for Minnesota, but Brooklyn has nothing to exploit it. Likely blowout, skip.
Mobley out for Cleveland; Powell and Wilson out, Claxton questionable for Chicago on a back-to-back. Two middling teams, skip.
